_readme: Acknowledgments for gated workbook changes (docs/stage-four.md §2). Append-only, no expiry. Each entry: {digest, note, date}. The digest covers sheet·key·col·kind + OLD value + new value of every gated change in the pull — the failing CI run prints the digest and the enumerated changes to acknowledge. The date is the acknowledged RUN's log timestamp (UTC date), never a guessed or local-clock date.
